claim_text: Iran has said there has been no progress on reviving the interim peace deal with the United States, according to a Reuters report carried in the 16 August 2026 cluster on the expiring US-Iran memorandum of understanding.
quote: Iran says no progress on reviving interim peace deal with US
confidence_justification: Attributed characterisation by one party to the talks, reported at second hand in a headline summary rather than from a transcript.
